body: Confirmed at PR418 head d99b49cf60ca570a36f18346d3a0fc11fff44e94. Root built unchanged source with Go1.27.1 Darwin/arm64 into a temporary diagnostic binary (not installed), reproduced the exact minimal docs/release.md fixture, ran manifest/build/search through actual CLI, and observed schema /2, operation search, one result. Thus the old schema predicate rejects a nonempty successful discovery response; it is not evidence that search returned zero results. Receipt and result: /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/corpus90-discovery-actual-receipt.json and corpus90-discovery-probe-result.json. Full CI logs retained as corpus90-hosted-shard2.raw.log/log. Installed Core remainsbuild163, Tasksbuild202. Searches installed discovery, corpus search, discovery workflows found no equivalent (V1-0474 is unrelated navigation evaluation). Both public repair cycles are exhausted; this record does not authorize a third repair.
